## Dead Grid 1.9.0: people who pull their weight

Android `.apk`, or play in the browser.

### What's new
- **Real skills.** Everyone has ten skills shaped by who they were: the retired cop shoots, the plumber fixes things, the nurse heals. Skills grow with use and change how well they work and fight.
- **Every feeling has a reason.** Tap anyone to see exactly why they feel how they do, such as "+8 Doing what they're good at" or "-7 Wasted here".
- **People act on their own.** Skilled survivors patch up the wounded, fix guns, shore up the wall, bring in harvests, cook for everyone and comfort each other without being asked.
- **The Foreman.** Jobs are assigned automatically to the best person for what the camp needs right now, scaling up for sickness, filth and thirst. Jobs you set by hand are respected for a while.
- **Standing orders** (People → Rules): Foreman, gate discipline, siege curfew, call to arms, repair crew, burning the dead, drone service, harvest rota and medical stock. All on by default.
- **New Cook job.** Stretches food and lifts mood.
- **Real conversations.** Ask what they're worried about and get an answer from what's actually happening in your camp. Ask what they're good at, thank them, practice with them, give them the day off, or put them on a new job. Options you've used disappear for the day.
- **The wall is no longer a force field.** It's 40% weaker, free repairs are nearly gone, and the dead pile up and climb over each other.
- **The gate.** Open lets scavengers and robots work outside, and lets the dead wander in. Shut is safe, but nothing comes home and people get restless. It opens and shuts by itself unless you take over.
- **Houses are useful.** Occupied buildings can be a Bunkhouse, Workshop, Canteen, Clinic, Lookout or Warehouse, run by your best person for the job. Spare beds now attract new survivors, each with their own skills, and having your own room lifts mood.
- **Everything is explained.** Tap any supply at the top to see where it comes from, how fast it's changing and how to get more. More → How it works covers the rest.
- **Medics can save the bitten.** With medicine, a medic may save someone in quarantine, depending on their skill.

### Fixes
- The siege curfew gets non-fighters in the HQ under cover during attacks.
- The camp now ends when nobody is left alive.

### Tested
- Simulated a hands-off sniper base (overrun on night 7) and a simple scripted player (night 10), with no script errors. The tests caught and fixed a Call to Arms bug that sent the whole camp to die. No human has played this balance, and it may be too hard. The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check, but has not been run on a physical phone.

## Dead Grid 1.8.0: the living world

Android `.apk`, or play in the browser.

**This changes how the game plays. It's much harder. Sitting behind a wall of snipers at 4× now gets you killed.**

### What's new
- **Guns need crews.** Crew comes from guards, wall crew and fighting robots. Guns without crew fire at a third of their speed.
- **The horde adapts.** If one weapon type does most of your killing, the next night hardens against it and sends what counters it.
- **New infected:** crawlers, armored riot dead, bloaters that explode on walls and guns, screamers that call more, stalkers that climb the wall, lobbers that shell your guns from beyond the wall, and dog packs by day.
- **Nights have a character:** swarm, climbers, bloat, armored, screamers, and blood moons every tenth night.
- **Three-way fights.** The dead attack bandits, and bandits shoot the dead, your people, your robots and your guns.
- **Firefights and hand to hand.** Bandits fight as riflemen, rushers, molotov throwers and looters. Survivors fight back at close range with whatever they carry.
- **Hand weapons:** craft spiked bats, machetes, pistols, shotguns, hunting rifles and SMGs in the Armory. Guards get the best first.
- **New defenses:** Grenade Launcher, Minigun, Claymore, Tar Pit and Flare Mast.
- **Smarter gangs:** they hit your weakest wall section, hold grudges, seize blocks after overrunning an outpost, fight each other and get overrun themselves.
- **Territory matters.** Blocks produce what's on them, such as medicine from a pharmacy block, at full rate if anchored by an outpost, gun or fortified building.
- **Buildings remember.** Paint marks show red X for picked clean, yellow slash for partly searched and green dot for untouched. Tap one to order a search, or fortify and garrison it on your land.
- **The world moves without you:** horde migrations, gang wars, supply plane crashes you race for, spreading building fires, air strikes, outbreaks in gang camps, refugees with the dead behind them. See More → The grid.
- **Big moments drop 4× to 1×.** You can turn that off in The grid.

### Fixes
- **Infection spreads far more slowly**, and killing the dead pushes it back.

### Tested
- Simulated a hands-off 16-sniper base (overrun on night 7) and a simple scripted player with mixed guns who kept building (reached night 16). No script errors. Every world event was triggered. These are first-pass numbers: no human has played this balance. The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check, but has not been run on a physical phone.

## Dead Grid 1.7.0: grit

Android `.apk`, or play in the browser.

### What's new
- **A new look.** Rust, worn metal, stencilled headings, hazard stripes and a film of grime across the whole game, with a dirtier, sepia map.
- **Bespoke people.** Survivors now differ in build, height, coat, scarf and pack on the map and in the bunker, on top of their unique faces. Raiders wear their gang's colours, masks and scars.
- **Raiders live in compounds.** Every gang is now a real settlement of named people. They scavenge, eat, recruit, and build tents, walls, watchtowers and plots you can see on the map. They expand with new camps and attack constantly.
- **They're worse at it than you.** No robots, no drones, thin income and impulsive spending. They scout badly, sometimes hit a guarded target, and sometimes empty their whole camp for a raid, leaving it exposed. When they starve, people desert, and some beg at your gate.
- **Raiders are people.** Every one you kill is gone from their roster, and survivors of a raid carry their loot home. Tap a camp for a scout report with their faces, numbers, buildings and who's out raiding. Destroying a camp can bring a surrender, and wiping out the roster ends the gang.
- **Survivors grow and change, Sims-style.** Everyone has an age, birthdays, a life goal, a daily wish and a life story in their profile. Completing a goal earns a lasting perk such as Master, Devoted, Veteran, Sentinel or Provider. Hard times leave marks too: Hardened after too many funerals, Broken after long despair, Survivor if they recover.
- **Their bodies keep the score.** Wounds leave scars, grief and age turn hair grey, hunger thins people out, beards grow. The very old can die in their sleep.

### Fixes
- The blank fortifications bar on bandit camps now shows a number.

### Tested
- In a desktop browser: simulated about nine days with two hostile gangs, watching raids, recruiting and deaths, with no script errors. Goals, perks, scars, grey hair and recovery were triggered directly, and all survived a save and reload. Raider balance and real long-game life progression haven't been played through.
- The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check. It has not been run on a physical phone.

## Dead Grid 1.6.0: the homestead

Android `.apk`, or play in the browser.

### What's new
- **Crop beds.** Place them right in your yard and choose what each one grows: potatoes, beans, corn, kale or herbs (which make medicine). Crops take water, change with the seasons, and only kale grows in winter.
- **Farmers tend them.** Each farmer or Harvester looks after 3 beds, walks out to them, and picks what's ripe. Untended beds grow slowly, and you can harvest by hand any time.
- **Scarecrows.** Crows eat any bed without a scarecrow within 30 m.
- **Soil.** Planting the same crop repeatedly wears the soil out. Rotate crops, or build a compost heap, which also speeds growth and eats corpses.
- **More ways to make food:** chicken coops lay eggs, a smokehouse halves spoilage and adds food storage, and a field kitchen lifts morale.
- **Home comforts:** campfires people gather around after dark, tents (+2 beds), storage sheds, rain barrels, washstands, benches and flower pots.
- **Build closer together.** Homestead pieces can sit side by side, and you stay in build mode so you can lay out rows. They're quiet to build, so gardening won't draw the horde.
- **Homestead panel** (More → Homestead): your beds, estimated food per minute, spare hands, wilting crops, exposed beds and a Harvest all button.

### Fixes
- The "Food running out" alert now opens the Homestead panel, and new alerts flag wilting crops, crows and ripe beds nobody is picking.
- Crop beds count toward how many farmers can work at full speed.

### Tested
- In a desktop browser: placement checks, every new building on the map, the panels, and about 250 in-game seconds of growth and harvests: no script errors. Winter, crows and soil loss over a long game weren't played through.
- The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check. It has not been run on a physical phone.

## Dead Grid 1.5.0: the long case

Android `.apk`, or play in the browser.

### What's new
- **Case 0047 is now a long story.** 20 case files, one every 10-15 nights survived (the first arrives on night 2), across about 265 nights. It builds to the truth about Harrow, Specimen 12-B and who you really are, and ends with a choice: open the gate, burn the mast, or keep the gate shut.
- **10 new defenses:** Spike Strip, Scrap Cannon, Harpoon Gun, Autocannon, Decoy Siren, Repair Pylon, Acid Sprayer, Shock Fence, Flak Battery and Railgun. Most unlock as you survive more nights. A new Gunsmith upgrade adds damage to every gun.
- **Drone roles:** set each drone as a Scavenger, Scout, Hauler, Gunship, Repair or Bomber drone.
- **Gangs are different every game,** with generated names, leaders and styles (looters, burners, drone hunters, swarms). New gangs can move in during long games. Friendly groups get varied names too.
- **New animations:** drones with spinning rotors and role colours, search lights on drones and robots searching buildings, muzzle flashes, track dust, blood and splatter.

### Fixes
- **New speed control:** a clear pause / 1× / 2× / 4× bar above the dock, replacing the old button. On a keyboard, Space pauses and 1, 2, 3 set the speed.
- **Speed no longer gets lost.** Dialogs and cutscenes pause the game on top of your chosen speed instead of overwriting it.
- Outposts no longer stay behind on blocks lost to the infection. A standing outpost now takes damage and holds the block.
- Drone launches use less fuel, and repeated messages stack instead of filling the screen.

Saves from before this version restart the case from file 1.

### Tested
- In a desktop browser: the speed bar through dialogs and pause, the new guns and drone roles in a simulated siege, the case file delivery and all the ending choices' code paths through one full ending. No script errors.
- The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check. It has not been run on a physical phone.

## Dead Grid 1.4.2: play in your browser

Android `.apk` only. Or play in the browser, on any device.

### What's new
- **Play in the browser** at https://unaveragetech.github.io/dead-grid/play/: the full game with every feature, on iPhone, iPad, PC, Mac or Android, with no download. It's the exact same build as the Android app and updates with every release.
- **Install it like an app.** On iPhone or iPad, tap Share → Add to Home Screen. On Android or desktop, use the browser's Install option. It gets its own icon, runs full screen, and keeps working offline once loaded.
- **Self-updating.** The browser version checks for new releases. When one is out, a "Reload to update" button appears, and your save stays put.
- On wide screens the panels stay a readable width instead of stretching across the window.

### Fixes
- The website now has a Play button in the header and on the home page, alongside the Android download.

### Tested
- Ran the browser version at phone and desktop sizes: the start screen, the map, panels, the bunker and the About panel all work. The offline service worker registers.
- The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check. It has not been run on a physical phone.

## Dead Grid 1.4.1: quieter rain and reliable downloads

Android `.apk` only.

### What's new
- **Sound settings** (More → Sound, or About → Sound settings): separate sliders for master volume, effects, music, ambience and weather, saved on your phone.

### Fixes
- **Rain is no longer deafening.** An old rain layer was still playing loud white noise underneath the newer rain sound. It's gone, and the remaining rain, drips and thunder are much quieter and softer, with a weather volume slider of their own. Measured on the game's output, rain used to push the whole mix about 4.5 dB louder; it no longer raises the overall level at all.
- **Downloads from the website are reliable.** The download buttons now link straight to a copy of the APK on the website itself, with no redirect to GitHub's storage servers, and they work even if the page's scripts haven't loaded. The GitHub release link is still there as a backup, along with a note about in-app browsers that block downloads.
- The in-app update check downloads from the same direct link.

### Tested
- Measured the game's audio output in clear weather and in rain, outside and inside the bunker, before and after the change.
- Checked that the website's download link responds directly with the APK, without a redirect.
- The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check. It has not been run on a physical phone.

## Dead Grid 1.4.0: deeper systems on the road to beta 2

Android `.apk` only.

### What's new
- **The workbench repair game.** Fix broken robots and drones in the workshop by hand: drag each part (chip, resistor, capacitor, diode, fuse) into its socket on the circuit board without touching the glowing live traces. Three zaps and the board fries. Heavier machines have more parts and more traces. Find it in Robots or Drones → Workbench.
- **Supplies are physical.** Outposts pile up what they produce. It only counts once it reaches storage at the HQ or a new **Depot** outpost, which adds storage space. Outposts next to the HQ or a depot, or joined to them by walls, are carted in automatically. Robots ferry supplies from the rest. Raiders steal unguarded piles first, and food rots if it sits too long.
- **Territory walls.** Build palisades from an outpost to its neighbours and back to the HQ. They stop the dead, link your supply lines, and get repaired by day after the dead break through.
- **A fleet that grows with your land.** Every 3 blocks you hold adds a drone pad, and each robot works outpost adds another, up to 10 drones.
- **No two survivors alike.** Every survivor gets a unique face (face shape, eyes, brows, nose, scars, freckles, earrings, masks, hats, grey hair) whose expression follows their mood. Each also gets their own hobby, habit, catchphrase and sleep schedule. They spend free time on their hobby, night owls stay up, and it all shows in their profile, thoughts and conversations.

### Fixes
- Robots now drop their current job to fetch large supply piles from outposts that aren't connected to storage.

### Tested
- Simulated about four in-game days with outposts, a depot, a palisade, robot ferrying and raids: no script errors. All 10 survivors came out with distinct faces, hobbies and catchphrases.
- The workbench game: a drag across a live trace registers a zap, and a completed board fixes the robot.
- The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check. It has not been run on a physical phone.

## Dead Grid 1.3.1: trailer and update checks in the app

Android `.apk` only.

### What's new
- **The trailer plays the first time you open the game.** It's built into the app, so it works offline. Tap Skip any time. You can watch it again from the start screen or More → About.
- **About & updates menu** (start screen, or More → About): shows your version, checks for updates, and has links to the website, tips & tricks, the changelog and bug reports.
- **Automatic update check** once a day when the game opens. If a new version is out, a banner on the start screen links straight to the download, which installs over your current version and keeps your save.

### Fixes
- Website links from inside the app now open in your phone's browser instead of replacing the game.

### Tested
- In a desktop browser: the first-launch trailer, Skip, it not replaying on the next launch, the About panel, the update check against the live website, and the update banner.
- The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check. It has not been run on a physical phone.

## Dead Grid 1.3.0: the frontier

Android `.apk` only.

### What's new
- **Outposts.** Develop any claimed block into a farm field, barracks, robot works, watchtower, cistern or salvage yard. Each can be upgraded twice. Your base grows into a scattered collective spreading out from the HQ, and every outpost has to be defended.
- **Farmland matters.** Each field lets two more farmers work at full speed, so food shortages now have a fix. Idle survivors go to work empty fields on their own.
- **The dead and the bandits hit outposts.** At night part of the horde goes for your outposts. A fallen outpost stops producing until your crew retakes it or you repair it.
- **Robot swarm.** New Harvester (works fields around the clock) and Warden (holds an outpost) robots. Post any robot to any outpost. Swarm protocol keeps building what the base needs. Robot works add capacity and cut robot costs.
- **Bandit camps.** Hostile groups build new camps closer and closer to you, raid your weakest outpost and steal supplies. Tap a camp to send your robots against it. Burn every camp and the gang scatters.
- **Territory panel** (More → Territory): every outpost, its health, its guards, what it produces, and the bandit camps around you.
- **15 new camp dilemmas,** including missing painkillers, a love triangle, a bandit defector, a leadership challenge, a stray dog, a funeral and a birthday. The same dilemma won't come back until several others have, and choices are remembered by the people involved.

### Fixes
- Crashed drones are now recovered almost automatically. The nearest free robot drops what it's doing to fetch one, stale recovery assignments are cleared, and if no robot is available the drone reboots and limps home on its own.
- Survivors no longer repeat the same thought all day. Lines rotate every few seconds, with many new ones.
- The same two survivors no longer have the same conversation over and over, and the camp's activity log skips near-duplicates.

### Tested
- Simulated about eight in-game days with outposts, the swarm, growing bandit camps and random answers to every dilemma: no script errors. A base with only starter turrets and no player input lasted to day 8.
- Drone recovery checked with and without robots available.
- The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check. It has not been run on a physical phone.

## Dead Grid 1.2.0: Case 0047

Android `.apk` only.

### What's new
- **Case 0047, the mystery under the outbreak.** Over your first six days, eight pieces of evidence surface. They come from a numbers station on the night radio, a drone find, a body at the gate, a horde that freezes and turns north all at once, and survivors who only talk once they trust you. Track it all in the new **Case file** (More → Case 0047). The beta's story ends on a cliffhanger.
- Evidence arrives with its own cutscene, and some of it comes up in conversation.
- **New beta trailer:** five real cities, the mystery, a tension score, and a very bad night.
- The website's screenshots and trailer now use public landmarks.

### Fixes
- The "perimeter pushed out" message shows a rounded distance instead of a long decimal.
- Cutscenes no longer draw over an open panel.
- The address box's example is now a public landmark.

### Tested
- In a desktop browser: all eight pieces of evidence, both conversation-delivered clues, the case file, a full night, dawn, deaths, recaps and a save reload. No script errors.
- The APK built, signed with the pinned key and passed the version check. It has not been run on a physical phone.
